title: Borrower Care Guide to Hardship Deferral Allowances on the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan
content:
## Hardship deferral allowances

For a documented hardship, the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan sets three figures per tier: the number of installments that may be deferred on a documented hardship, the number of hardship deferrals allowed over the life of a loan, and whether interest stops accruing during a hardship deferral.

| Tier | Installments that may be deferred on a documented hardship | Hardship deferrals allowed over the life of the loan | Interest stops accruing during a deferral |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 500 | 0 | 0 | No |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 1 | 1 | No |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 2000 | 1 | 1 | No |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 | 2 | 1 | No |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 | 2 | 2 | No |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | 3 | 2 | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Paystride Payroll Loan 500.** Both figures are 0: no installment may be deferred, and no hardship deferral is allowed over the life of the loan.
- **Two separate limits.** The first figure limits how many installments one deferral may cover; the second limits how many deferrals the loan may have in its life. A Paystride Payroll Loan 3000 loan may defer up to 2 installments, but only once; a Paystride Payroll Loan 4000 loan may defer up to 2 installments, up to twice.
- **Interest.** In no tier does interest stop accruing during a hardship deferral.

## Hypothetical cases

| Tier | Deferrals already approved on the loan | Installments asked to be deferred | Within both figures |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 0 | 1 | Yes |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 1000 | 1 | 1 | No, the life-of-loan figure of 1 is already reached |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | 1 | 3 | Yes |
| Paystride Payroll Loan 5000 | 0 | 4 | No, more than 3 installments |
